finding: Sanitized merge erased stored camera credentials
impact: Ordinary recovery could disable working cameras
change_or_recommendation: Preserve local secrets in sanitized merge; replace only credential-inclusive data
validation_or_acceptance: Real SQLite and AES-GCM decryption regressions verify preserved and replaced passwords

finding: Restore failed to remap explicit stream-profile references
impact: Restored layouts and rotations referenced nonexistent profiles
change_or_recommendation: Remap cameras/profiles/layouts/groups/displays and all selected-profile references
validation_or_acceptance: Encrypted round-trip and whole-configuration reference tests

finding: Nested configuration graph lacked validation and reliable atomicity
impact: Malformed or late-conflicting restores could damage usable state
change_or_recommendation: Validate schemas and references before mutation; use explicit transaction/savepoint rollback
validation_or_acceptance: Invalid replacement, late merge conflict and caller-transaction rollback regressions

finding: Revision replacement and active-wall selection were inconsistent
impact: Merge could violate revision uniqueness or select an unintended draft
change_or_recommendation: Flush old revisions before replacement; retain exported current revision and one active wall
validation_or_acceptance: Revision collision/current-revision/active-merge tests using real SQLite

finding: Routine edits replaced profile identity/metadata and altered password whitespace
impact: Manual stream choices broke after harmless edits and valid secrets could change
change_or_recommendation: Update profiles in place; preserve metadata and exact secrets; support legacy name matching and safe swaps
evidence: src/mosaivue/services/cameras.py; frontend/src/forms.ts; frontend/src/pages.ts; camera service and JavaScript form tests
validation_or_acceptance: ID preservation, foreign IDs, rename/swap and exact-password regressions; rendered interaction blocked

finding: Deletion and selected-profile ownership checks were incomplete
impact: Current layouts or rotation entries could become unusable
change_or_recommendation: Reject deletion of referenced objects and reject profiles belonging to another camera
validation_or_acceptance: Camera/layout/rotation service reference-validation tests

finding: Malformed overrides and edge rounding produced invalid output rectangles
impact: Tiny tiles could disappear and saved overrides could overflow a smaller display
change_or_recommendation: Validate schema/bounds; clamp origins and positive dimensions against actual output
validation_or_acceptance: 11 focused geometry tests passed; schema tests cover malformed and out-of-bounds overrides

finding: Password changes retained other sessions and first setup could race
impact: Old sessions survived credential rotation; concurrent setup could create multiple admins
change_or_recommendation: Revoke other sessions and serialize first-admin creation with SQLite immediate transaction
validation_or_acceptance: Cookie revocation and simultaneous setup integration regressions

finding: Concurrent startup could publish competing master keys
impact: Credentials could be encrypted with a key later overwritten
change_or_recommendation: Publish a fully written key atomically using exclusive link; use unique temporary files
validation_or_acceptance: Concurrent 24-call publication test verifies one key and restrictive permissions

finding: Mutation events preceded commit and SSE sessions stayed valid too long
impact: Refreshes could read stale state and revoked users could keep receiving events
change_or_recommendation: Commit before publication; recheck SSE authorization using short database sessions
validation_or_acceptance: Separate-connection event ordering plus revoked/expired/disabled session tests

finding: Archive expansion/upload reads and exception details were insufficiently bounded
impact: Memory pressure and credential-bearing exception text could escape
change_or_recommendation: Bound upload/expanded sizes and members; sanitize expected and unexpected import failures
validation_or_acceptance: Oversized expansion, wrong passphrase, malformed archive and redacted-error regressions

finding: Probe success/latency and saved transport did not reflect actual measurement
impact: Diagnostics could claim successful video or decoded-frame latency without evidence
change_or_recommendation: Require valid discovered video; report discovery duration honestly; honor transport and preview-disable setting
validation_or_acceptance: Controlled discoverer/thumbnail and API regressions; physical first-frame timing remains unmeasured

finding: IPv6 reconstruction and named URL-secret redaction were incomplete
impact: IPv6 streams could break and diagnostics could expose query credentials
change_or_recommendation: Preserve bracketed IPv6/ports; validate URLs; redact userinfo and named sensitive query fields
validation_or_acceptance: IPv6 round-trip, malformed URL and diagnostic redaction tests

finding: Slots sharing one group also shared a cursor
impact: Independent rotating tiles advanced each other unexpectedly
change_or_recommendation: Maintain a cursor per slot and initialize each independently
validation_or_acceptance: Shared-group independent-tile controller regression; physical playback pending

finding: Automatic substream choice was lost after the first cut
impact: Small tiles could switch to main streams and increase decode load
change_or_recommendation: Recompute tile-appropriate profile on rotation and preconnection
validation_or_acceptance: Automatic-substream rotation/preconnect contract tests; hardware load unmeasured

finding: Partial layout rejection and invalid focus damaged existing playback state
impact: A failed action could leave a partial wall or canceled rotation
change_or_recommendation: Resolve sources before mutation; restore prior specs/dimensions on synchronous failure; validate focus first
validation_or_acceptance: Partial failure, invalid focus and first-use focus tests; asynchronous readiness remains open

finding: Failure modes and disabled-group behavior were not implemented consistently
impact: Unavailable cameras could block progression and disabled groups kept advancing
change_or_recommendation: Implement distinct Skip/Hold behavior and skip unavailable/disabled cameras
validation_or_acceptance: Skip/Hold/disabled group regressions; placeholder remains compatibility-only

finding: Changing transport/latency with the same profile ID did not replace the source
impact: Reapplied layouts could retain old connection settings
change_or_recommendation: Include transport, latency and source dimensions in source-diff decisions
validation_or_acceptance: Transport/latency source-replacement regression

finding: Overnight windows used the wrong weekday and ambiguous boundaries
impact: Monday night schedules could miss Tuesday morning or overlap a transition
change_or_recommendation: Anchor to starting day; make end exclusive; define equal times as 24h; deterministic ties
validation_or_acceptance: Schedule matching tests cover weekdays, midnight, end boundaries and equal-time windows

finding: Substring matching attributed errors to the wrong slot
impact: A healthy tile could be restarted for a similarly named failing camera
change_or_recommendation: Match actual element ownership and ancestry including prepared branches
validation_or_acceptance: Controlled element ownership tests; real pipeline error qualification pending

finding: Transport and presentation settings diverged from saved controls
impact: UDP/auto preferences, opacity, layer or geometry could be ignored
change_or_recommendation: Honor initial arguments and supported D-Bus geometry/layer commands with restart fallback
validation_or_acceptance: Command/control contract tests; firmware and physical D-Bus behavior unqualified

finding: Compositor output was fixed at 5 fps
impact: More capable appliances had no supported output-rate tuning path
change_or_recommendation: Add MOSAIVUE_OUTPUT_FPS integer 1..60 while retaining default 5
validation_or_acceptance: Parser/caps tests; requested rates are not verified device performance

finding: RPC framing/errors and canceled-task cleanup were inconsistent
impact: Large status frames or shutdown could produce failures/pending tasks
change_or_recommendation: Use 1 MiB framing, typed errors/timeouts and joined rotation/focus cancellation
validation_or_acceptance: Controlled protocol tests pass; real AF_UNIX round trip skipped by environment

finding: Python prerelease text had incorrect Debian upgrade ordering
impact: A beta package could compare newer than the subsequent stable release
change_or_recommendation: Map canonical Python prereleases to Debian tilde suffixes: 0.1.0b3 becomes 0.1.0~b3
validation_or_acceptance: Focused version mapping/rejection and dpkg ordering tests; actual installation remains unqualified

finding: Editing reset ordering, weights, profiles and start position
impact: A rename could silently change wall behavior
change_or_recommendation: Preserve configuration and expose ordering/weights/profiles/start; add Resume
validation_or_acceptance: JavaScript rotation-data tests; rendered controls and physical cuts pending

finding: Dirty changes and locked tiles lacked consistent protection
impact: Navigation lost work and locked tiles could still mutate
change_or_recommendation: Add dirty-state guards/save exclusion; enforce lock across mutations; clamp numeric edits
validation_or_acceptance: JavaScript lock/undo/profile/geometry tests; browser navigation assertions not run

finding: Cancel buttons, error parsing and asynchronous pages failed ordinary interactions
impact: Invalid forms could trap users; errors were unreadable; stale routes replaced newer views
change_or_recommendation: Use explicit cancellation, single body read, field errors and per-route render roots
validation_or_acceptance: JavaScript API regressions and strict TypeScript build; browser tests supplied but blocked

finding: Sanitized JSON export passed a parsed object to createObjectURL
impact: Download JSON could throw instead of saving the export
change_or_recommendation: Serialize JSON responses into a Blob while preserving binary backup bytes
validation_or_acceptance: Focused tests capture JSON/binary Blob bytes, filename, CSRF and URL cleanup; no browser-pass claim

finding: Service-writable metadata and old linked entries crossed the root update boundary
impact: Privileged updates/removal could consume replaceable paths
change_or_recommendation: Protect directory/metadata ownership; reject linked entries; atomically replace root-consumed metadata
validation_or_acceptance: Shell helper regressions; full root/systemd migration not executed

finding: An unrelated nonempty prefix could be populated then recursively removed
impact: Installation/removal could destroy preexisting unrelated data
change_or_recommendation: Constrain/canonicalize prefixes, reject nonempty unrelated targets and validate removal marker
validation_or_acceptance: Path/metadata/link helper tests; disposable-host uninstall acceptance required

finding: Staging depended on rsync and lint was not an enforced gate
impact: Development packaging or code-quality regressions could go unnoticed
change_or_recommendation: Provide filtered Python staging, reject private runtime artifacts and add Ruff CI gate
validation_or_acceptance: Ruff and compilation pass; release builders/manifest checks in final validation record

finding: No ONVIF profile import workflow
impact: Users had to locate and enter stream URLs manually
change_or_recommendation: Inspect explicit Media1 device endpoints and import selected profiles with compatible credentials
validation_or_acceptance: Controlled SOAP/Digest/Basic/error/API fixtures; physical camera interoperability unqualified

finding: Scheduler API had no browser management screen
impact: Timed day/night walls required API or database-oriented setup
change_or_recommendation: Add schedule create/edit/enable/disable/delete with day/time/priority semantics
validation_or_acceptance: Strict TypeScript and supplied browser CRUD workflow; rendered execution blocked

finding: Only featured-camera templates were available
impact: Common equal-tile monitor layouts required manual placement
change_or_recommendation: Add 2×2, 3×3 and 4×4 grids in creation and editor using existing apply/history flow
validation_or_acceptance: JavaScript exact-count/bounds/coverage/nonoverlap tests; no hardware capacity guarantee

finding: Camera/layout copying and large-list filtering lacked convenient UI
impact: Repeated setup and finding cameras took unnecessary work
change_or_recommendation: Expose disabled camera copies, draft layout copies and richer query/status filters
validation_or_acceptance: Filter/data tests and strict build; rendered duplicate flows pending

finding: Successful configuration restore did not distinguish display application
impact: Users could assume HDMI had applied a restore when the daemon had failed
change_or_recommendation: Commit before application; return renderer status; show persistent warning/action in UI
validation_or_acceptance: Backend import/application response regressions; browser warning rendering not verified

finding: Rendered desktop/mobile workflows have not executed successfully here
impact: Build/unit success cannot establish actual control usability
change_or_recommendation: Run included E2E workflows on a host where Chromium can launch; inspect screenshots/console
validation_or_acceptance: Pass all browser workflows at desktop and 390×844; current AF_UNIX startup restriction is a blocker

finding: Modified renderer has no new camera/HDMI qualification
impact: Regression or capacity claims cannot be inferred from controlled objects
change_or_recommendation: Qualify Pi 3B+/OMX, ROCK Pi/GStreamer and Ubuntu; measure Pi 4/5 separately
validation_or_acceptance: Record cold boot, failures, motion continuity, resources and 24–72h soak on actual devices

finding: Full installation/upgrade/rollback/removal was not executed on disposable systemd hosts
impact: Helper tests cannot prove ownership, service startup and rollback end to end
change_or_recommendation: Rehearse clean installation and 0.1.0b2 upgrade including forced failures and retained data
validation_or_acceptance: Verify services, key/database consistency, token consumption, rollback and conservative removal

finding: Stored display/presentation fields exceed implemented backend capabilities
impact: Controls can imply unsupported audio, portrait, synchronization or placeholder behavior
change_or_recommendation: Expose explicit backend capabilities and disable or label unsupported controls
validation_or_acceptance: For each enabled control prove observable hardware effect; otherwise mark unavailable

finding: Synchronous rollback does not wait for decoded first frames
impact: An accepted new layout can still fail asynchronously and appear blank
change_or_recommendation: Add per-stream readiness window and explicit last-known-good acceptance policy
validation_or_acceptance: Fault-inject accepted-but-never-decoding sources and demonstrate reliable previous-wall recovery

finding: Camera and some rotation edits do not refresh existing renderer specs automatically
impact: Saved changes can remain unapplied until layout reapplication
change_or_recommendation: Add pending-change indicators and explicit apply/reload revisions without silently canceling focus
validation_or_acceptance: Prove URL/profile/interval edits apply predictably to an active wall while preserving unrelated tiles

finding: Real multi-output, portrait and whole-wall playlists are absent
impact: Direct display competitors support common monitor configurations not covered here
change_or_recommendation: Model connectors separately; implement orientation and per-output playlists on one qualified platform
validation_or_acceptance: Show two independent physical walls, portrait output, reconnect recovery and playlist controls

finding: Known-endpoint Media1 import lacks discovery, Media2 and PTZ
impact: More camera ecosystems and operator controls remain unavailable
change_or_recommendation: Add explicit WS-Discovery, Media2 and PTZ/presets in measured stages; retain manual RTSP
validation_or_acceptance: Cross-vendor fixtures and real devices cover auth, clock, certificates, aliases and supported controls

finding: Settings are weakly typed and configuration backups omit appliance state
impact: Invalid settings or incomplete recovery can leave an unusable appliance
change_or_recommendation: Add backwards-compatible typed settings and versioned backup sections with restore preview
validation_or_acceptance: Validate existing settings; rehearse recovery including renderer overrides, CA files and required OS configuration

finding: Concurrent previews have no shared appliance-wide budget
impact: Authenticated requests can compete with HDMI decoding on small boards
change_or_recommendation: Add bounded capture queue/cache and per-device resource budgets
validation_or_acceptance: Measure concurrent-preview CPU/memory and show the live wall remains responsive

finding: Opaque bearer tokens in stream paths remain stored/exported as URL text
impact: Password-field encryption does not protect every vendor stream secret
change_or_recommendation: Encrypt complete secret-bearing URIs or model their protected components explicitly
validation_or_acceptance: Demonstrate opaque path tokens absent from plaintext DB, exports, support bundles and logs

finding: Admin flag and AuditLog model do not provide full roles or audit workflows
impact: Team deployments lack scoped access and attributable change history
change_or_recommendation: Add viewer/operator/admin management, revocable integration tokens and bounded secret-free audit events
validation_or_acceptance: Role-denial and token-revocation tests plus actor/resource/action audit coverage

finding: Health is transient and OMX Playing does not prove moving video
impact: Frozen streams and long synchronous operations can be difficult to diagnose
change_or_recommendation: Add true frame-liveness metrics, bounded history, alerts and a serialized long-operation queue
validation_or_acceptance: Detect frozen decode separately from running process; measure API latency under slow camera operations

finding: Control UI offers previews rather than a full browser live wall
impact: Remote viewing differs from browser-video competitors
change_or_recommendation: Consider optional local MSE/WebRTC restreaming and scoped automation integrations; keep NVR scope deliberate
validation_or_acceptance: Verify local-only video, auth isolation, upstream connection reuse and resource impact
